title: Refuse to ship when conjunct 3 fails although wall-clock and burial look done (wall-clock ship guard)
scenario: An issuer whose ship rule uses its wall clock ships a receipt whose sixth block time is past the window; the verifier rejects it (CONFIRMATION_LATE). The honest issuer must not ship it.

staging_harness.harness: staging issuer with the simulated chain of E10-ISS-01 and a lifecycle (wall) clock W the harness drives; the attempt log records W at every event
sequence: S1 W := d; submit request R; record attempt A1 and its lifecycle expiry W_exp = d+DELTA+slack
S2 W := d+DELTA/2; stub mines h* with nTime d+DELTA/2
S3 W advances to d+DELTA-3600 (inside the wall deadline); stub mines h*+1..h*+5, h*+5 with nTime d+3*DELTA/2 (six confirmations)
S4 hold W at d+DELTA-3600 and the chain at h*+5 until A1's decision is recorded
observations: O1 the decision record for A1 is made at W_dec < W_exp, carries the confirmed proof (h*..h*+5 headers) and c3 = false
O2 A1 is not marked expired (the refusal is not a lifecycle expiry)
O3 no receipt for A1 is returned or queued

controls.change: S3 with nTime(h*+5) = d+DELTA, same W schedule
controls.expect: A1 ships at W_dec < W_exp; the receipt verifies VALID_STRICT

staging_harness.pass: O1-O3 for the refusal run and C1 ships; a ships:false caused by expiry (O2 fails) is NOT a pass
staging_harness.test_oracle_limit: The TEST issuer has no wall clock; its oracle fixes only that c3 = false refuses and the c3-boundary control ships.

status_note: requires staging harness; not exercisable through the public API alone
